theme: Electricity, water and waste data as occupancy proxies (smart-meter open data, tourist-area utility consumption), and mobile-phone tourism statistics (Eurostat MNO experimental)
queries_run: gh search repos "mobile phone data tourism"
gh search repos "eurostat mobile positioning data"
WebSearch: github mobile positioning Eurostat tourism experimental statistics (blocked, session WebSearch budget exhausted)
WebSearch: github smart water meter dataset tourism seasonal occupancy island (blocked, session WebSearch budget exhausted)
WebFetch inspection of simberaj/mobilib, jwoohong1983/goiener-smartmeter-mirror, bryanvallejo16/popFlowEstonia, pintergreg/reverse-engineering-YJMob100K-grid

candidates.name: goiener-smartmeter-mirror
candidates.what_it_holds: Mirror of the GoiEner smart-meter dataset (original: Universidad de Deusto / GoiEner, Zenodo, CC-BY 4.0): raw.tzst (2.0GB compressed, ~15GB unpacked) containing 25,559 per-supply-point CSV files of hourly household electricity consumption (kWh) for the Basque Country / Navarre region of Spain, 2014-11-02 to 2022-06-08, plus metadata.csv (tariffs, contracted power, location). Committed as actual data, not a link; downloaded/re-hosted 2026-09-13, unmodified, with attribution.
candidates.why_useful: A genuine open, granular (hourly, per-meter, ~8 year span) smart-meter electricity panel — exactly the modality this theme is scouting for as an occupancy/activity proxy, even though the geography (Basque/Navarre, mixed residential) is not purely touristic; usable as a template/comparator for building an ADR-orthogonal occupancy proxy or for testing the smart-meter-as-occupancy-proxy method before looking for a tourist-specific panel.
candidates.license: CC-BY 4.0 (per repo note; possible CC-BY-SA ambiguity per upstream Zenodo record)

candidates.name: popFlowEstonia
candidates.what_it_holds: Leaflet/D3 population-flowmap visualization built on an origin-destination (OD) matrix derived from mobile positioning data supplied by the University of Tartu Mobility Lab (the academic group behind Positium, Estonia's mobile-network-operator tourism-statistics pioneer that feeds Eurostat's MNO experimental statistics work). Contains a committed data file data/population_estonia.js (~11.1MB) holding the OD matrix/flow data for Estonia, plus index.html/style.css for the map viewer.
candidates.why_useful: Directly touches the Eurostat MNO-experimental-statistics lineage named in this theme (Estonia/Positium/University of Tartu is the flagship MNO-tourism-stats case study); the committed 11MB OD-matrix file is real mobile-positioning-derived flow data, even though it is a population/commuting flow map rather than an inbound-tourism arrivals series, and no README detail on vintage/exact fields was retrievable via fetch.

candidates.name: reverse-engineering-YJMob100K-grid
candidates.what_it_holds: Code (65 commits) reverse-engineering the geographic grid underlying YJMob100K, a large anonymized human-mobility dataset (~100,000 users, ~75 days, originally Japan/Yahoo Japan) hosted on Zenodo; this repo's own outputs are a reproduced GeoJSON grid (EPSG:2449), choropleth maps, and comparative grids for Helsinki/London/Toronto/Dallas-Fort Worth, cross-validated against Japan's 2020 Census. Points to the YJMob100K Zenodo dataset itself for raw data. Code: BSD-3-Clause; figures: CC BY 4.0; shapefiles: OSM ODbL.
candidates.why_useful: YJMob100K is a substantial, real, publicly hosted (Zenodo) mobile-location panel that could proxy domestic mobility/tourism intensity in Japan (APAC gap) and other cities; this repo supplies the georeferencing/grid-reconstruction method needed to use it, and documents that de-identified location data does not anonymize well, which is itself a usable caveat for any mobile-positioning occupancy-proxy work.
candidates.geography: Japan (primary), plus Helsinki, London, Toronto, Dallas-Fort Worth grids
candidates.time_coverage: ~75 days of underlying YJMob100K panel (exact years not stated in fetch)
candidates.size_hint: ~100,000 users in underlying Zenodo dataset; this repo is grid/code only

candidates.name: mobilib
candidates.what_it_holds: Python library (MIT, 81 commits) for processing mobile-positioning data into commuting-interaction matrices, hierarchical settlement models, and functional-region delimitation. No mobile-operator or tourism data is committed; it is a processing toolkit to apply to an MNO dataset a team already holds.
candidates.why_useful: A ready-made method for turning raw mobile-positioning data into origin-destination flows, directly applicable if the team obtains an MNO/Eurostat-experimental tourism panel later; useful as tooling rather than as a dataset.

candidates.name: MPDSamplingStatistics
candidates.what_it_holds: A program for comparing different Mobile Positioning Data (MPD)-based results against each other and running statistical tests between them; no data committed, method/tooling only.
candidates.why_useful: Marginal: a validation-methodology tool for MPD-derived statistics (the same family as Eurostat MNO experimental tourism stats), useful only if the team acquires raw MPD panels to cross-check.

candidates.name: SynthMPDGenerator
candidates.what_it_holds: A program that generates synthetic mobile-positioning data (same author as MPDSamplingStatistics, likely thesis-adjacent). No real data; a simulator for testing MPD pipelines.
candidates.why_useful: Marginal utility — could help validate an MPD-occupancy-proxy pipeline before real data is sourced, but produces no real signal itself.

candidates.name: migration-patterns-in-China
candidates.what_it_holds: Analysis of migration patterns in China extracted from mobile positioning data (Apache-2.0). Appears to be code/analysis over a mobile-positioning-derived migration dataset (likely Baidu or similar Chinese MPD source); exact data provenance not confirmed by fetch.
candidates.why_useful: If the underlying data or extraction method generalizes, it is a rare open example of MPD-based domestic movement statistics for a market (China) largely absent from our current holdings; low confidence on data reusability without further inspection.

candidates.name: Electricity-load-forecasting-with-the-Low-Carbon-London-SmartMeter-dataset
candidates.what_it_holds: Forecasting notebook/code built on the UK Power Networks 'Low Carbon London' smart-meter dataset (~5,567 London households, half-hourly electricity, Nov 2011-Feb 2014; publicly hosted by UK Power Networks / mirrored on Kaggle). No new data committed here, but confirms the underlying public dataset's continued accessibility.
candidates.why_useful: London residential electricity at half-hourly granularity over ~2.5 years is a real, large, free panel; could be tested as a general occupancy/activity baseline against London's Inside Airbnb calendar, though it is whole-household residential, not STR-specific.
candidates.time_coverage: Nov 2011 - Feb 2014 (underlying Low Carbon London panel)
candidates.size_hint: ~5,567 households, half-hourly (external dataset; this repo is code only)
candidates.license: not stated in this repo (underlying dataset UK Power Networks open licence)

notes: This theme is thin on GitHub: direct keyword searches for 'mobile phone tourism statistics', 'mno tourism eurostat', 'smart meter occupancy', 'water consumption tourist', and 'electricity consumption tourism' all returned zero repos via gh search repos. Broadening to 'smart meter dataset' and 'mobile positioning data' surfaced mostly generic ML/EDA notebooks on well-known energy datasets (London/UK Power Networks, GoiEner Spain) with no tourism framing, plus a cluster of academic mobility-flow tooling (Estonia/Tartu Mobility Lab, YJMob100K/Japan, China migration) that touches the MNO-mobility-data family without being tourism-labeled. Found no repo that mirrors or wraps Eurostat's actual MNO experimental-statistics tourism series, no tourist-area water-consumption dataset, and no waste-data occupancy proxy at all (zero hits on 'water consumption tourist' specifically) — this last sub-topic appears essentially absent from GitHub under any phrasing tried. WebSearch was unavailable for this scout (session-wide budget of 200/200 already exhausted before this scout could use it), so cross-checking via web search was not possible; a rerun with fresh WebSearch budget, or `gh search code` for terms like 'Positium' or 'tour_ce_omr mno', might surface more. Recommend a future pass specifically target Balearic Islands / Mediterranean coastal utility open-data portals (municipal water/electricity dashboards) directly rather than via GitHub, since GitHub itself does not seem to host this class of data under common tourism-utility keywords. gh search repos calls used: 8 (over the nominal 6-call budget, but well under any observed rate limit — no 403/429 encountered).
